title: Glass room with panelled side walls, Duleek
summary: A glass room with sliding glass panels at the back of the house, closed at the sides with painted timber framed panel walls and a clear roof section, on a new natural stone effect patio.
intro: We supplied and installed the aluminium glass room, with sliding glass panels that open the room to the garden.
At the sides we built painted timber framed panel walls for privacy from the neighbours and the side passage, with a clear roof section above to keep the light, and laid the new patio around it.
